text:
Noah Kim: quick follow-up from the postmortem chestnut  saw the same failure mode: large initial rollout + no automated leash -> wide outage. want a minimal set of changes we can ship fast.
Priya Nair: agreed. let's aim for micro-rollouts by default and a fast abort leash that triggers on short spikes.
Diego Morales: i'll prototype a rollback leash. heuristic: monitor 3m windows and abort if error_rate delta > 2% OR p95 climbs > 35% vs baseline.
Lina Chen: i'll add a "blast_cap" layer in the flag service so any single flag can't expose more than N concurrent users unless explicitly allowed. defaults conservative.
Noah Kim: also add a "safety_leash" tag on flags that have ever triggered an abort so we can prioritize audits.
safety-bot: note: infra-ticket created https://redwood.internal/INF-4999 for rollout controls experiment.
Diego Morales: plan: 1) rollout schema with leash config + enforcement hooks 2) unit+integration tests with replay harness 3) telemetry: emit abort_event with reason. ETA: PR by Mon 2026-03-30.
Lina Chen: plan: cap enforcement middleware + admin UI toggle + dashboard tile for active users per-flag. ETA: Wed 2026-04-01.
Priya Nair: i'll update the postmortem action tracker, runbook, and add an "abort incident" template for oncall. also want a recurring report for flags with >1 leash event in 90 days.
Noah Kim: good. small canary plan: enable leash+caps on two low-risk routes and monitor for false positives for 48h before wider rollout.
Diego Morales: i'll include a replay using the last incident traffic (sanitized) so we can validate thresholds.
Lina Chen: happy to pair on tests Thu morning.
Priya Nair: action items (adding to tracker): 1) Diego - leash schema + PR + replay tests (due 2026-03-30) 2) Lina - blast_cap middleware + dashboard (due 2026-04-01) 3) Priya - runbook & abort-incident template + 90d report ticket (due 2026-04-03) 4) Noah - canary coordination + tracker updates (due 2026-03-29).
Noah Kim: i'll run a 15-min sync Fri to go over PR links and gating. drop PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: ack. starting runbook edits now.
Diego Morales: branch created feat/leash-control, pushing tests shortly.
Lina Chen: dashboard mock uploaded to the design doc.
Noah Kim: thanks all  we'll keep using this thread for quick updates and blockers.
